en.html: She spat, quite deliberately. Her opinion was reasonable. When a large man stands silent behind a tree, the usual assumption is that fear has nailed him there. As far as what I had actually done went, there was no difference. Having watched another person in danger and done nothing, I had no right to complain about what she thought of me. An apology was due. I lowered my head, with due solemnity.

en.html: Only after explaining did I notice that the forest was a fortunate place for it. The argument could be heard as criticism of the regime. To put it mildly, the Rokuhara shogunate did not exist chiefly to protect human rights. If I delivered such a lecture loudly in town, the shogunate's ears—posted everywhere, in violation of the very privacy under discussion—might hear it and have me tied up. There were plenty of precedents. And the listener would be dragged in along with the speaker. Caution was advisable. The girl before me, though, did not seem bothered. She only stared as if she had bitten an unripe persimmon.

en.html:
Kageaki"Go straight in this direction. The village is there."
Ichijou"R-right."
Kageaki"Please understand. You must go exactly straight."
Ichijou"Fine, fine, I understand... When there is a tree I will go round it. That is allowed, no?"
Kageaki"It is not."
Ichijou"NOT!?"
Kageaki"A person of your artistic gifts will get lost from that alone."
Ichijou"Stop calling me artistic! Then what am I supposed to do!?"
Kageaki"Preferably, jump over them."
Ichijou"How can anyone jump a tree!?"
Kageaki"Then adopt an aggressive policy: advance straight ahead, smashing every tree that stands in your way."
Ichijou"What am I, a brown bear!? Also, that is deforestation! I do not need all this. I just go over there, straight, right? I will not get lost!"
Kageaki"That 'over there' of yours is already off by slightly under thirty degrees. I find it unconvincing."
Ichijou"...Just a small misunderstanding."
Kageaki"For you, it is not possible."
Ichijou"Do not say it so quietly with that blank face! Enough. Bye. At least I will thank you for showing me the way."
Kageaki"Your thanks I gratefully accept. But rather than thanks, please put your attention into going straight. Already you are turning."
Ichijou"A-ah. Yes."

Kageaki"That 'over there' of yours is already off by slightly under thirty degrees. I find it unconvincing."

Ichijou"...Just a small misunderstanding."

Kageaki"For you, it is not possible."

Kageaki"Your thanks I gratefully accept. But rather than thanks, please put your attention into going straight. Already you are turning."

Ichijou"A-ah. Yes."
